note: The historical YIELD defect, verbatim: a RED field carrying a WHITE legend on an entry that declares a white face with a red legend. Both declared colours are painted and nothing undeclared is, so the set-membership colour rule passes it — this is the fixture that proves the gate now measures which colour is the FACE. Note what does NOT fire: a white legend sitting on red is indistinguishable, node by node, from a legend knocked out of a red shape. Which colour holds the face is the only thing that tells an inversion from a knockout, and that is measured by area.
